S.FORM: alang Cihalaay ga niya mki sku Karing Keng atu Zosi go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 65 buwan, 116 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 35% kyan ku 41 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 65% kyan ku 75 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Amis 34%, binah lihuyan s'uli 2%. maki qu ngasal bziran, ngasal psatu tegami ru pqniqan iyu. rhzyal kki'an tay 'llaw na Cihalaay hya' ga rgyax. tay 'zil na Cihalaay hya' ga llyung. tay mkyahu' na Cihalaay hya' ga llyung. tay mkraya' na Cihalaay hya' ga llyung. tay 'zil na Cihalaay hya' ga Talampo. rekisi kayal kyokay qalang Cihalaay ga ungat kyokay. ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan qalang Cihalaay ga ungat pqwasan biru. tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ [ʦ|ʨ]iħalaaj ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku kariŋ keŋ atu zo[s|ɕ]i ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa ** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku ** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku ** ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ami[s|ɕ] ** βinaħ liħujan [s|ɕ]ʔuli * maki qu ŋa[s|ɕ]al βziran ŋa[s|ɕ]al p[s|ɕ]atu teɣami ru pqniqan iju rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔllaw na [ʦ|ʨ]iħalaaj ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax taj ʔzil na [ʦ|ʨ]iħalaaj ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkjaħuʔ na [ʦ|ʨ]iħalaaj ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkrajaʔ na [ʦ|ʨ]iħalaaj ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj ʔzil na [ʦ|ʨ]iħalaaj ħjaʔ ɣa talampo reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj qalaŋ [ʦ|ʨ]iħalaaj ɣa uŋat kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan qalaŋ [ʦ|ʨ]iħalaaj ɣa uŋat pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
